sections.Profile:
Mundial 90 , also known as Flip-VI , was released by Inder in 1990. This soccer-themed pinball machine was a part of the company's effort to combine pinball with arcade-like elements. Mundial 90 was a traditional pinball game, while its counterpart Flip-VI included a video screen and joystick controls, providing players with a hybrid experience.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1990
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Dual Theme, Soccer, Sports, Original Theme, 1990s, Solid State, Hybrid pinball
